scope: Plan only. No old frozen archive/evidence, root C plans, native session, or gallery website was changed by this task.
decision_rule: Use an official vendor component only when its actual source and relevant reuse terms are verified. Otherwise use accurate separate compatibility typography with original generic workflow geometry drawn through MCP. Preserve observed semantics; do not invent or trace missing vendor icons.

common_native_workflow.authoring_and_exports: DCC-MCP typed operations in the actual Inkscape host; every created document/export requires its own execution receipt.
common_native_workflow.source_copying_rule: Historical SVG containers are references, not editable-vector proof. New SVGs must contain actual vector objects and no bitmap logo embedding.
common_native_workflow.font_scope: Use the case Montserrat assets only with their existing OFL notices if distributed; no vendor-proprietary typography is reused.
common_native_workflow.publication_scope: Gallery may describe a unified restoration with vendor-sensitive adaptations, not an exact reproduction where a protected badge is replaced.
review_requirements: Shared C curvature and spacing match the parent-approved v2 master.
Each family retains its listed actual workflow semantics and product referential label.
Partial GUI previews are not treated as full asset acceptance.
Per-file notices/overrides are carried into the new manifest and archive.
common_native_workflow.tiny_icon_scope: Fine workflow accessories are optically simplified rather than scaling every detail.

adobe.finding: Prior written license or equivalent authorization is required to incorporate Adobe product logos or icon designs into a third-party product/company/app mark.
conditions: Use accurate for-use-with wording and generic product descriptors.
DCC-MCP identity remains more prominent.
Include Adobe trademark attribution and avoid implied endorsement.

autodesk.finding: Referential compatibility phrases have conditions; product icons and logos require prior permission under a specific agreement.
conditions: Use a separate for / for use with / compatible with phrase.
Keep the project name more prominent.
Include the vendor trademark and non-affiliation footer.

maxon.finding: Website graphics remain protected and reuse requires contacting the website owner; no public permission to rebuild or incorporate ZBrush/Cinema 4D glyphs into this plugin brand was established.

derivative.finding: Official TouchDesigner program icons cannot be modified or incorporated into third-party plugin/product branding.
conditions: Use a separate referential phrase such as integrates with TouchDesigner.
Use an independent operator-network motif; the name is less prominent than DCC-MCP.

sidefx.finding: Press/partner assets and supplied-wordmark rules do not establish permission to recreate a Houdini swirl or combine it with a plugin brand.

foundry.finding: The March 2026 web terms protect Branding and do not grant a Branding license; personal website-content permissions are not a public plugin-logo grant.

audiokinetic.finding: Official trademark/plugin policy endpoints were found; exact logo-use terms could not be verified.
verification_gaps: Body fetch returned 403 or empty 202 challenge.
No approval is inferred from a repository logo or a press download.

vicon.finding: Website terms allow limited noncommercial use, restrict standalone graphics/modification, and grant no additional IP rights.

blender.finding: The logo is a separate trademark outside GPL and must not serve as the third-party project logo.
conditions: Reference Blender separately and keep DCC-MCP prominent.
A separately presented credit mark, if later used, must follow the official unchanged-art rules.
verification_gaps: Direct logo-page open returned 402; the same official page content was available in the search index.

godot.finding: The logo artwork is CC BY 4.0, but the press policy says it must represent Godot rather than the third-party project.
conditions: Preserve aspect ratio and attribution if used separately.
Do not imply Godot developers endorse this project.
No combined-logo integration permission is inferred.

unity.finding: Official Unity logos must remain unmodified and clearly separate; permitted logo uses and attribution are restricted.
conditions: Use an accurate compatibility phrase and required attribution.
Do not combine/imitate the cube mark as this project identity.

epic.finding: The current branding route leads to the Epic brand portal; this collection has no executed trademark-license agreement.
verification_gaps: No permission to redraw the Unreal U glyph or merge it into DCC-MCP is established.

openusd.finding: TOST 1.0 section 6 does not grant product-name/trademark permissions beyond required notices.
conditions: Scene composition/layer semantics may inform original workflow geometry.
Do not trace the official nested-corner USD emblem.

trimble.finding: The guidelines do not themselves authorize marks and prohibit combining Trimble marks with third-party trademarks.
conditions: Use accurate referential product wording.
Do not copy the SketchUp cube glyph or vendor trade dress.

gimp.finding: The official page identifies current Wilber by Aryeom Han and permits reuse/adaptation under CC BY-SA 4.0.
conditions: Use the actually collected current official source, not the historical AI mascot interpretation.
Attribute Aryeom Han, source URL and CC BY-SA 4.0; mark changes.
Use CC BY-SA 4.0 for the GIMP derived lockup files and provide editable source.
Represent a GIMP integration; avoid claims of official GIMP sponsorship.

krita.finding: The policy permits identifying Krita as a distinct software component and compatible products without confusion.
conditions: Krita remains a secondary referential identity.
A future official-mark use requires the exact current asset and its artwork-license attribution.
verification_gaps: An official icon file with its specific artwork copyright/license was not collected here; do not trace the old raster badge.

tiled.finding: The software distribution has per-component licenses; site terms do not transfer trademark rights.
conditions: Use independently drawn map/tile workflow geometry.
verification_gaps: No asset-specific logo or integration-brand permission was established.

material_maker.owner: Material Maker / Rodolphe Suescun and contributors
material_maker.finding: The official repository MIT license covers software/documentation; it is not treated as a blanket product-mark license.
verification_gaps: No separate mascot/logo integration policy was established.

comfy.finding: The official terms and frontend GPLv3 source do not establish a separate permission for the product glyph in this combined brand.
verification_gaps: No specific yellow C-mark integration-brand license was established.

marmoset.finding: The EULA preserves software/library rights and ownership of user-created works; this is not a logo-skull reuse grant.
verification_gaps: No asset-specific plugin-brand permission for the skull was established.

freecad.finding: The FPA reports registered name/logo rights; no permission to combine the F/gear glyph into this product brand was established.

openscad.finding: The GPL software license is recorded separately from the logo artwork and trademark question.
verification_gaps: No specific green/yellow CSG-logo integration permission was established.

renderdoc.finding: The official MIT software license was checked; no independent brand/avatar integration permission was established.

mgear.finding: The mGear software MIT grant is not extended to an unverified product-badge trademark grant.
